access_contract: Only explicit configuration metadata; no model, tokenizer, source labels or response files opened.
boundary_contract: Verify encode(prompt)==saved prefix IDs without rewriting them. Tokenize each canonical numeral alone without special tokens; require decode(continuation)==surface and decode(prefix+continuation)==decode(prefix)+surface, with skip_special_tokens=False and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False. Reject special/EOS numeral tokens and decoder boundary edits. This explicitly declared standalone rule does not jointly tokenize prompt+candidate.
eos_union: distinct disjoint variants, summed for each candidate
event_definition: decode-verified standalone canonical integer tokens followed by one declared EOS ID
limitation: Absolute masses cover only the declared finite integer-plus-EOS events. Support-conditional entropy and margin describe that restricted set; they are not overall full-answer confidence. Each event uses one declared standalone token sequence. Other tokenizations producing equivalent text are outside this event set. Exact saved prompt IDs and decoded concatenation are verified; joint prompt-plus-candidate retokenization is not required by this rule.
preparation_stage: declaration only; actual prompt/standalone-token decoder checks remain pending
